title: Using the slowest observable in one-dimensional Markov processes to construct quasi-exactly-solvable generators with two explicit levels
summary: The construction of Quasi-Exactly-Solvable quantum Hamiltonians where only the first two eigenstates $Φ_0(x)$ and $Φ_1(x)$ of energies $E_0$ and $E_1$ are explicit is revisited from the point of view of one-dimensional Markov processes satisfying detailed-balance, whose generators are related to quantum Hamiltonians via similarity transformations. Here, the lowest energy vanishes $E_0=0$ and is associated with the conservation of probability and with the steady state $P_*(x)$, while $E_1>0$ is the rate that governs the exponential relaxation towards the steady-state, and is associated with…
